findings.claim: The residual-11 fix (c732427b1) closes only the `--`-inside-single-quoted-SQL-data spelling. The sibling spelling `/*` ... `*/` inside single-quoted SQL data — the SAME defect class (a SQL comment marker inside quoted DATA whose extent the raw byte scan cannot decide) — is still open. The routing predicate sql_comment_extent_needs_lexer (backend/ci/gates/writer-ownership/src/lib.rs ~1140-1163) routes `--` seen while in_single to the lexer but its `else if bytes[i..].starts_with(b"--")` branch (line ~1158) omits `/*`, so a `/*` inside single quotes is NOT routed to sqlparser and falls to without_sql_comments_byte_fallback, whose past_block_comment treats the quoted `/*` as a real comment opener and deletes everything up to a `*/` in a later quoted fragment — including a plainly-written `UPDATE employees` between them. A hostile probe against the REAL published `scan()` proves the write is dropped (employees_write_charged=false) while both canaries confirm the probe file parsed and was scanned.
findings.failureScenario: A non-owner crate carrying production DML shaped like `"UPDATE t SET note = 'a /* b'; UPDATE employees SET org_unit = 1; SELECT 'x */ y'"` in one Rust string literal passes the writer-ownership gate (fail-OPEN) even though it writes an owned table it does not own. This is the identical evasion the gate pins for `--` (known_residual_a_dash_inside_quoted_sql_data_hides_a_later_statement); the lexer was adopted as the total primitive for exactly this class, then wired to cover only one of its two markers.
findings.ownerLeaseRationale: Deferred (not this-train blocking) because: (1) pre-existing — the same hole exists at merge-base 7b568df9d and on origin/main (which has no sqlparser fix at all), so this train STRICTLY IMPROVES the gate by closing the `--` spelling; (2) outside the residual-11 leaf's declared+pinned scope, which is genuinely closed and green; (3) contrived reachability. Record as a bead against the writer-ownership owner. Minimal remedy is mechanism-completion, not a new mechanism: extend sql_comment_extent_needs_lexer so a `/*` seen while in_single also routes to the lexer, and add a `/*`-in-quoted-data case to known_residual_a_dash_...(rename/extend the pin). Integrator MAY pull this into the train; the regression probe is ready. Flagged so an APPROVE cannot silently stand over a proven fail-open in the exact function the train modified.
